project.description:
The layer that runs a consensus algorithm and a storage engine into a running database. This module exists because of a dependency that deliberately does not exist elsewhere: raft module can't see storage, so Raft can never learn that the bytes it replicates describe key-value operations. Something has to know both, though, because a committed log entry has to become a write. That translation happens here, and only here.
This module owns the parts that need a real clock, real threads and a real network - everything the consensus core was carefully built without, so that it could be tested against a fake clock in a single thread.
